newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it killed 32 Kurd guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it killed 32 Kurd guerrillas.

text.p: Security forces have killed 32 Kurdish guerrillas in a week of clashes in southeastern Turkey, the emergency rule governer's office said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement said the clashes took place in six southeastern provinces, but gave no figures for military casualties.
More than 21,000 people have died during the 12-year conflict between security forces and Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas, fighting for autonomy or independence from Ankara.
